title: Simulation: the connector between two operations is one straight rapid; the posted program lifts Z first

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
## What happens

`camcraft_sim::sim::script` puts one straight rapid between two operations: from the end of the last operation to the start of the next one (`crates/sim/src/sim.rs:551-571`). The posted program does not move like this:

- The engine calls `onToolChange` for each section, also for a repeated tool (`crates/post/src/post/tool_change.rs:5,57-67`).
- The milling posts then retract for the tool call and make the first X/Y traverse with the #1616 / #1633 law: a Z-only rapid to the clearance, then X/Y alone (`assets/posts/fanuc.cps:666-675,833-848`, `assets/posts/grblhal.cps:550-566`).

Thus the simulation can show a diagonal rapid between two operations that the machine never makes. The verdict per operation does not judge this connector (`crates/sim/src/verify/sweep.rs:90-95`), so the post is not affected. Only the replay and the drawn path are wrong.

Found during the research of #2899. Work it after #2901: today the next start is the WCS origin, after #2901 it is the entry point.

## Where

- `crates/sim/src/sim.rs:551-571` (the connector seg).
- `crates/app/src/stock_play.rs:77-84` and `crates/app/src/stock_play_head.rs:62-74` count the connector.

## What is expected

The connector follows the posted order: up to the start height of the next operation (or the higher of the two clearances), across in X/Y, then down. A connector stays one logical connector for the playback counters.

## Done when

- A sim test with two operations at different clearances shows that no connector seg has X/Y motion and Z motion together.
- The playback counter tests in `crates/app/tests/` stay green.

Refs #2899
